answer: Locks are published in comet, expire in orchard, and spiral lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 50 aliases thus needs 126 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 829 identities would post 1261 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
